import fs from "fs";
import path from "path";

const dep = process.argv[2] || path.join(process.env.HOME, "sovereign-dispersal-monolith");
const outDir = "./recovered_tau";

const IGNORE = new Set(["node_modules", ".git", "target", "dist", "build", ".next", ".turbo"]);
const EXTENSIONS = new Set([".ts", ".rs", ".py", ".sh", ".go"]);

  /\btau\b/i,
  /telemetric/i,
  /telemetry/i,
  /hud/i,
  /s_ctx/i,
  /eta_gen/i,
  /h_cog/i,
  /ev_cog/i,
  /v_gen/i,
  /omega_ctx/i,
  /cognitive/i,
  /capture-pane/i
];

const recovered = [];

function scan(dir) {
  let entries;
  try { entries = fs.readdirSync(dir, { withFileTypes: true }); } catch { return; }

  for (const entry of entries) {
    if (IGNORE.has(entry.name) || entry.name.startsWith(".")) continue;
    const fullPath = path.join(dir, entry.name);

    if (entry.isDirectory()) {
      scan(fullPath);

      const nameMatch = TAU_PATTERNS.some(p => p.test(entry.name));

      let contentMatch = false;
      let matchedTokens = [];
      try {
        const content = fs.readFileSync(fullPath, "utf-8");
        for (const p of TAU_PATTERNS) {

            matchedTokens.push(p.source);

        fs.copyFileSync(fullPath, targetPath);

        recovered.push({ source: fullPath, target: targetPath, tokens: matchedTokens });
        console.log(`[RECOVERED] ${relPath} (matches: ${matchedTokens.join(", ")})`);
      }
    }
  }
}

scan(dep);

console.log(`\nSuccessfully staged ${recovered.length} tau-related files into ${outDir}/`);
